status: interim, one full-scale training seed per architecture (42)
dataset: RoboTwin qfix, 512 previously evaluated validation pairs, 415 unique episodes, disjoint from Stage 1 training
selection: latest available numbered difference-IDM checkpoint at evaluation start, 8000 updates
comparison: standard-IDM archived FP32 per-pair predictions and posterior means; row and donor identities matched
timing: Shared-machine elapsed times include uncontrolled concurrent workloads and evaluation overhead. Used for operational records only.
metrics: mean over pairs and valid components; normalized state deltas; future DINO feature MSE with true posterior mean; no future-blind policy rollout
intervals: paired episode cluster bootstrap. 10000 draws, fixed trained models. Crossfit intervals additionally condition on out-of-fold predictions, not repeated seed or training-set uncertainty
crossfit: same episode folds for every frozen representation; five outer folds, five inner folds, alpha selected on inner folds only
probe2048: separate ridge fit on original 2048 training pairs, episode-wise 5-fold alpha selection; evaluate on 512 validation pairs. Identical protocol for the DINO baseline using train-only PCA.
dino_control: spatial average of frozen features at each endpoint, future minus current, 32 training PCA components, concatenated with current state; fold-local PCA for ridge selection
primary_comparison: Both models at 8000 optimizer updates and batch size 64. Unequal-step records are descriptive only.
